calls.thesis: Largest oilfield technology company; Middle East Q3 revenue +13% sequentially, Venezuela revenue expected to more than double, and data-center solutions revenue +76% YoY to $230M - 'exposure to two major infrastructure spending cycles in one stock.'
calls.base_case: Theme-level base case: producers must restart investment just to offset the ~8% annual natural decline in oil production, shifting earnings growth from explorers into equipment/services.
calls.bull_case: Theme-level bull case: three catalysts - Venezuela restoration (~$183B to return to 3M barrels/day), Middle East rebuild (~$58B in energy repairs), and AI data centers (~$3T infrastructure by 2030) - could add hundreds of billions in demand.
calls.bear_case: Theme-level bear case: the majors may keep limiting spending to protect prices (the discipline that caused the equipment lag in the first place), delaying the turnaround.
